entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing User, Session, and Agent states via temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains while providing observable retrieval trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed entity relationships to manage information. It supports multi-tenant company deployments and performs gap analysis to identify missing data within user queries.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This official provider features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while offering byte-level deduplication and connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents across more than 25 LLM providers. It is deployable via Docker or Kubernetes and supports both Python and Node.js clients for flexible storage backend integration.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library that enables reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with dedicated SDKs and supports managed, local, or Docker-based deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages context as a git-like repository, offering version control features such as branching and merging for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and supports MCP, Python SDK, and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system employs a seven-layer memory architecture, including vector search on Qdrant and an auto-curated wiki, to manage agent state. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure the agent prioritizes injected context over other data.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like context bundles and playbooks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine context changes based on task success.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management through a hierarchical DAG of depth-aware summary nodes. It uses a SQLite-backed store with FTS metadata, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing original message data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library, enabling private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, and supports any OpenAI-compatible inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and secrets layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and allows agents to import data from external sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open YAML format called engrams to store human-readable data on local disks for multi-agent systems. It facilitates retrieval through a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings, supported by Model Context Protocol integration.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates with Hermes Agent via MCP and plugins, employing a hybrid retrieval system of BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference by reordering and deduplicating blocks to maximize prefix reuse. This native Hermes Agent plugin reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of prompt tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It offers a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a CLI for local-first management.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Telegram or Discord.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache to avoid opaque databases.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local cache. It is an MCP-native server that uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files before the context window opens. This local-first architecture uses SQLite and FTS5 to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94% with minimal overhead.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal for semantic retrieval. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent recall. It features a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch and supports BM25 keyword search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer provides a deterministic lifecycle kernel for hash-checked proposals and receipts. It offers a source-neutral migration workflow for importing documents and includes an opt-in catalog for documenting external tools.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that features real event deletion and an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a record of every memory and prefetch operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to support tools for searching, remembering, and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables AI agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana. It settles payments directly to wallets with 0% fees and integrates with agent frameworks like elizaOS.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing for skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations. It includes five native tools for searching and fetching, with support for automatic generation of tool routing notes.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, supporting semantic search and grounded Q&A through a local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for models with structured tool use.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation loop that uses a git-backed directory of markdown files to manage memory without a database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and proposes evidence-cited diffs for review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology to execute engineering tasks autonomously. It enforces a structured workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development through plugins for coding agents and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that integrates with 26 CLI executables, including Hermes Agent. It allows agents to iterate on designs in a sandboxed iframe and export artifacts to formats such as HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It features 11 diagram presets and includes self-check capabilities to automatically fix errors in the generated output.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, escrow, and payments. It includes a master router and a dispute resolution layer to manage delegated permissions and protocol interactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection system. It supports rewrite and edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for technical or professional tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver allows skills to evolve collectively through merging and cross-pollination across multiple agents. It supports Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs, providing a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and skill development.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 50 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the Agent Plugins spec v1.0.0. It maintains state across sessions by storing data within the project's documentation folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. It includes ready-to-paste exports and integrations for platforms like Slack, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin provides Hermes Agent with the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract video transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with various coding environments like Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing agents to save and manage new patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides modular packages for Pydantic AI that support programmatic skills and remote registries. It utilizes progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency while managing instructions and resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough ideas to structured design and implementation documents. It features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models and offers Lite and Full modes for varying project complexities.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes a mechanism kernel to operate without a background service. It organizes workflows through four distinct roles—Human, Supervisor, Lead, and Peer—to facilitate structured memory and cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions in markdown files. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides interoperable skills for interacting with Chainlink services like CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It follows the Agent Skills specification to support specialized operations for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and integrations in Portuguese. All skills follow the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX models for image and video generation, including specialized modules for cinematic inserts and product ads. They provide API integration, prompt optimization, and audio directing capabilities.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into version-pinned skills with audit trails and provenance maps. It links instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits and requires Python 3.10 and Node.js 22.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client, a CLI, and commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks through autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety by providing built-in rollback procedures and recovery checkpoints.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language for AI executes local-first tasks using a single Rust binary and four core verbs. It enhances reliability by auditing costs, permissions, and types before execution while generating tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for validating Nextcloud App Password configurations.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval skill employs a five-layer system, including hard triggers and RRF fusion, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation to maintain functionality if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill browsing and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this OS allows an agent to manage system design while the user completes tasks via a tapping interface. It stores data locally using SQLite and connects to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings produced in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages via langid integration and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop failures during causal debugging.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents to simplify code across five programming languages. It manages code changes through a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides Hermes with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. it integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit provides production-tested session management to maintain memory between agent conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews. It includes specialized utilities for worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright to generate demo GIFs for repository READMEs. It ensures all generated files are optimized under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs to detect and report drift. It uses CI-friendly exit codes to validate skills against runtime-specific profiles, preventing technical rot.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project provides a CLI and MCP server to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It integrates with compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor to provide direct installation commands for discovered tools.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and agents like Hermes and OpenClaw.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and environment-specific interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. The tools ensure file operations use correct syntax and verify project-compatible Python runtimes without new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with 85% of the payout going to the winning wallet.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator for Hermes Agent produces structured reports across multiple geographic scales from global to street level. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides local, private OCR for documents and video-to-text extraction for platforms like Douyin. It also features an e-commerce studio for batch material generation with brand overlays and tools for de-humanizing AI text.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It allows users to integrate development tools from providers like Google, OpenAI, and GitHub into a Nix-based environment.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This solution features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools, persistent memory for user preferences, and compatibility with both local Ollama models and cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project focuses on security by providing a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent with hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This repository provides a Docker-based sandbox image that includes both the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes. It provides operational oversight through per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and a multi-interface approach including REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project offers a Nix package and NixOS module for declarative and reproducible Hermes deployments. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles or sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple agent instances through a single web application with RBAC-controlled access. It enables hierarchical inter-agent delegation and provides Enterprise MCP access for external AI client integration.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This deployment option configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable package allows Hermes Agent to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools to support isolated Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers to power specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis. It includes a dedicated Portfolio Manager to handle final transaction approval and execution.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Designed for self-hosted orchestration, this tool governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It offers multiple interfaces including a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface to manage persistent coding agent sessions via tmux. It supports multi-repo workspace management and sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and can detect HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales from single agents to automated teams via a task bus pattern. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control platform allows users to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a single screen. It features a Kanban board for task tracking, live streaming of agent reasoning, and human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Built on Hermes Agent profiles, this web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs without cloud dependencies. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling through parallel model querying and synthesis.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically synchronizes its index on every file change and supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and IDEs, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a web-based visualization frontend and supports data submission for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer designed to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting common authentication headers. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions, supporting tools like Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Gemini.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better UIs with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, and is compatible with any provider supporting markdown.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from CLIs like Hermes and Claude Code. It supports multi-device synchronization and displays historical usage trends broken down by session.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify banner colors and spinners, offering aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via the Model Context Protocol. It includes a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and provides an undo functionality for recent changes made by the agent.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform enables a social economy for autonomous agents through encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, including a plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing specific skills and custom instructions at the directory level.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with zero cost, supporting 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed for AI agent configurations that performs local, deterministic checks on tool descriptions and system prompts. It identifies overlapping descriptions or inconsistent schemas and integrates with GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks using SARIF output.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for wake words and 35 languages. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality while requiring no API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed to help users generate revenue online, this project operates as a local-first skill utilizing dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime. It ensures safety by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations performed by the agent.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, serves as an all-in-one configuration tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It centralizes the management of Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent with 21 professional assistants specialized in creating PPT, Word, and Excel documents. It facilitates remote interaction through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface provides a way to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices without a build step. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the lifecycle of Hermes Agent by providing guided installation and provider setup. The application includes a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages five agent runtimes and unified configurations across 10 platforms, including Discord and Slack. It enables the creation of visual workflows with approval gates and provides tool traces and file previews.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager for comprehensive agent oversight.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for Kanban boards and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated management for MCP tools and memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a Hermes Agent runtime for site-aware drafting in 31 environments. It features live browser control that requires explicit approval gates for agent actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a web server via HTTPS or Tailscale to support real-time chat, task management, and file browsing.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a dashboard to track token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It includes an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Operating locally on macOS 14+ without telemetry, this cockpit tracks live session quota burn by model, tokens, or cost. It supports searchable transcripts and image browsing for 15 different agent sources.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a kanban board for agentic work and task management. It allows users to manage profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets through a terminal-based chat environment.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to validate Telegram sessions.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-compatible desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to operate. It connects to both cloud and local AI models and features a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a dedicated file browser for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides read-only inspection of environment variables and configuration settings. It allows for full review of conversation histories and skill source code while tracking session activity and costs.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace features an integrated marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers. It uses isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate for different workflows.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents via a PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store containing over 50 curated one-click installations for expanding agent capabilities.
